memories.content: The caucus has been leafleting against the memorandum. They want the local to oppose it.

The local's executive board has not yet issued a press release about the port automation memorandum. The international union endorsed a similar deal at another port last month. The local is considering whether to issue a press release before Monday (2026-08-31).
